title: 3 Crypto Strategies Most Beginners Pick the Wrong One
description:
3 Crypto Investing Strategies for Beginners

I break down three crypto investing strategies for beginners: buy and hold long term, day trading for experienced traders, and my hybrid plan—hold 50–60% of my crypto long term and take profits on the rest at preset Fibonacci exit targets (with an Ethereum example). My main point is to have a clear plan for when to buy, hold, and sell, and avoid day trading if you’re not tracking the market daily.

All of my thoughts are just that, me sharing my thoughts. None of this information is financial advice. Please do your own research and seek help from professionals before investing or making financial decisions. 

#crypto #cryptocurrency #vechain #xrp #btc #3twarrioracademy #xrp #cryptobeginners #howtoinvestincrypto #dollarcostaverage #Debt #CreditCardDebt #2030 #financialchange #WLFI #DonaldTrump ##FINANCIALRESET #griddown #SHTF


00:00 Crypto Investing Overview
00:24 Buy and Hold Strategy
01:33 Day Trading Explained
02:15 Hybrid Exit Plan
03:38 Fibonacci Exit Targets
04:04 Ethereum Sell Example
06:08 Rules and Recommendations
06:49 Channel Wrap Up
